description: Fork of exp336 (40.44 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6475) replacing ALL LUT modules (qkv_lut, v_lut, out_proj, residual_lut) with SoftMultiHeadLUT(hard=False) — truly soft forward (softmax-weighted sum over 2^NAP rows). Temperature is annealed log-linearly from soft_temp_start=5.0 to soft_temp_end=0.05 over 8000 steps. At step 1 the softmax is very flat (near-uniform mixing over rows); at step 8000 it is sharp (near-argmax, almost hard). Shape unchanged from exp336 (E=64, d_v=16, all tphs=64/16/32/64). Tests whether annealing from soft to hard provides better LUT training than the TinyMHL hard-forward + soft-backward path.
